# Artem Prokhorov (Prokhorov®)

> Artem Prokhorov is an independent web designer and developer who designs and builds websites from structure to launch, and works on UI/UX for digital products.

- Role: Independent Web Designer & Developer
- Based in: Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan (UTC+6); works remotely worldwide
- Languages: English, Russian
- Contact: contact@helloprokhorov.com; WhatsApp +996 702 33 35 09

## Services

- Web Design: Structure, UX and visual design for websites that are clear, visually strong and easy to understand.
- Website Development: The approved design built as a responsive, fast website that matches the layouts and is ready to launch.
- Website Motion: Motion for websites and interfaces: transitions, scroll motion and hover states that show what’s clickable and keep your place between pages.
- UI/UX Design: User flows, wireframes and interfaces for digital products, with a design system where the product needs one.
- Design Direction: Visual direction for websites and products: typography, colour, layout and interaction principles that keep them consistent.

## Pricing (USD), international

Fixed packages, so you know roughly where a project sits before we talk. Most projects land between $2,000 and $4,000.

- Homepage Sprint: $490, 5 days. Homepage structure and design. The fee counts toward the full project if we carry on.
- Landing Page: $1,200, 2 weeks. One page: structure, copy structure, design, responsive build, a form, analytics and launch.
- Website, up to 6 pages: $2,200, 3–4 weeks. Up to 6 pages with a CMS, forms, basic SEO, analytics and launch on your domain.
- Website, 7–12 pages: from $3,500, 5–6 weeks. The same, plus CMS collections (blog, case studies) and motion.
- Design Only: Landing Page: $600, 1–2 weeks. Structure, user flows, desktop and mobile layouts, ready for development.
- Design Only: Website: from $1,200, 1–3 weeks. Structure, user flows, desktop and mobile layouts, ready for development.
- Development of Your Design: from $900, 2–3 weeks. A responsive build of your approved design, basic SEO and launch.
- Website Motion: from $450, 1–2 weeks. Transitions, scroll motion, hover and focus states, with reduced-motion support.
- UI/UX Design: from $1,200, 3–6 weeks. User flows, wireframes and interface design for a digital product, with a design system where it needs one.
- Design Direction: from $600, 1–2 weeks. A visual direction: typography, colour, layout and interaction principles.
- Website Care: $200 a month. Up to 3 hours of edits a month, updates, checks on analytics and forms. Only for sites I built.
- Website Growth: $450 a month. Up to 8 hours a month: new sections and landing pages, A/B tests, conversion improvements. Only for sites I built.
- White-label for Agencies, hourly: $35 an hour, by scope. Figma to code or Framer, no contact with your client, NDA.
- White-label for Agencies, fixed: from $800, by scope. Figma to code or Framer, no contact with your client, NDA.

- Price: Fixed once the scope is agreed.
- Payment: Through Contra: 50% to start, 50% before launch. Projects from $3,000: 40% to start, 30% when the design is approved, 30% before launch.
- Revisions: 3 rounds included; each round is one consolidated set of comments. Extra work is quoted in writing first.
- Rush: Timeline cut in half: +30%.
- Async: By default: reply within 24 hours on weekdays, Loom progress updates twice a week, no meetings required.

The price depends on scope and number of pages, how complex the site is, how much UX work it needs and the visual direction. Motion, development requirements, the materials you already have and the timeline matter too. Final price is fixed once we agree the scope.

## Pricing in Kyrgyzstan (KGS), on /ru/

Цены для проектов в Кыргызстане, чтобы ещё до встречи понимать, о каких суммах речь.

- Лендинг под ключ: 60 000–90 000 сом, 2 недели. Форма, WhatsApp, аналитика, подключение домена.
- Сайт до 6 страниц с админкой: от 95 000 сом, 3–4 недели. Структура, дизайн, сборка, админка для простых правок, базовое SEO и запуск.
- Сайт на 7–12 страниц: от 160 000 сом, 5–6 недель. То же, плюс разделы вроде блога или проектов и моушн.
- Дизайн без разработки: от 45 000 сом, 1–3 недели. Структура, сценарии, макеты под десктоп и мобильные, готовые к разработке.
- Поддержка: 15 000 сом в месяц. До 3 часов правок в месяц, обновления, присмотр за формами и аналитикой. Только для сайтов, которые я сделал сам.
- Поддержка + SEO: 30 000 сом в месяц. До 8 часов в месяц: статьи, ссылки между страницами, новые блоки. Только для сайтов, которые я сделал сам.

- Цена: Фиксированная, когда договоримся об объёме.
- Оплата: Договор и предоплата 50 %. Остаток — перед запуском.
- Правки: Три круга. Круг — это один общий список комментариев. Дополнительную работу сначала оцениваю письменно.
- Срочность: Если срок нужен вдвое короче: +30 %.
- Встреча: Можно встретиться лично в Бишкеке или работать удалённо, как вам удобнее.

Цена зависит от числа страниц и сложности сайта, от того, сколько нужно UX-работы и насколько сложный визуал. А ещё от анимации, требований к разработке, готовых материалов и сроков. Точную цену назову, когда договоримся об объёме, и дальше она не меняется.

## Case studies

- [Powermatic®](https://helloprokhorov.com/work/powermatic/): Brand identity and a multi-page website for Powermatic Technologies®, a technology partner for growing businesses. Designed in Figma and built in code.
- [Supaminds](https://helloprokhorov.com/work/supaminds/): A multi‑page website for Supaminds, a consultancy that helps businesses make smarter decisions, solve complex challenges and move forward with confidence.
- [Visual Hunters®](https://helloprokhorov.com/work/visual-hunters/): A web concept exploring bold typography and 3D in web design. Built as a personal experiment in visual direction and layout systems.
- [Contour Office©](https://helloprokhorov.com/work/contour-office/): A typographic website concept for accounting and CPA firms, built on restraint and structure — grid, proportion and a design manifesto as the visual language.
- [Renovate](https://helloprokhorov.com/work/renovate/): A website for Renovate, a business transformation firm with a stripped-back approach: precise, structured solutions that drive measurable value.
- [Lattice](https://helloprokhorov.com/work/lattice/): A multi‑page website concept for an infrastructure control plane — “on‑prem that operates like the public cloud”, for teams that run their own hardware.
- [Luma](https://helloprokhorov.com/work/luma/): A landing page concept for Luma, a product that scans incoming interactions from different sources and orders them by their estimated conversion potential.
